text: Madonna's Sex drew action from libraries and customs authorities. The Tokyo Customs Office ruled that portions of the book were obscene and seized copies brought in by travelers at airports. In Houston, TX, Citizens Against Pornography sought to have it removed; the public library kept it but stopped circulation and restricted in-library access to adults. In Mesa, AZ, the mayor ordered the library not to shelve it. The Pikes Peak (CO) Library in Colorado Springs and the St. Louis (MO) Public Library each cancelled their order after citizen protest.
